stemMd: A vehicle uses 7.5 litres per 100 km. Fuel costs 1.80 euros per litre. What is the fuel cost for 240 km?
explanationMd: The trip uses 7.5(2.4)=18 litres. Multiplying by 1.80 gives 32.40 euros.

distractorRationale.a: Uses 10 litres per 100 km rather than 7.5.
